== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ホス：雪原の塹壕</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
'''Light''' — <span lang="ja">ここでは自分の各武器運命数にそれぞれ１を加える。</span>

'''Dark''' — <span lang="ja">ここを支配しているなら、自分のフォース生産に＋１。</span>

== Lore ==
The card has no printed lore box.

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Hoth: Snow Trench (2nd Marker)]].

'''Lore''' — The card has no printed lore box.

'''Game text''' — Light Side. Add 1 to each of your weapon destiny numbers here. Dark Side. If you control this site, your Force generation is +1.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Printed title is 雪原の塹壕, with 第２マーカー as a separate marker label. Light adds 1 to each 武器運命数 here. Dark Force generation +1 if you control. One Light Force icon and one Dark Force icon.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-L-hothsnowtrench.gif|Original English face]], [[Hoth: Snow Trench (2nd Marker)]].</ref>
